messages:
Anna (CS): CedarHealth asked for a focused 90-min hands-on workshop next week to finish data-plane onboarding + inference tuning. They want a live run through: routing, model pinning, and basic perf tweaks.
Matt S (Solutions): I can lead the infra + tuning portion. Prefer mornings (PST) next week.
Julie - CedarHealth: Thanks! Our engs are in PST/EST split. Wed/Thu mornings PST work best. Can do Thu 10:30am PT for 90m.
Anna (CS): Thu 10:30am PT = Thu 13:30pm ET — works for us. Rafael, any objections to slotting a canary run in the last 20 mins?
Rafael (CS Lead): Sounds good. Let's reserve the last 20 for a canary migration + fallback drills. Also want to capture action items in the recording.
Matt S (Solutions): Agenda draft: 1) 10m intro + goals 2) 30m infra walkthrough (routing/pinning) 3) 25m tuning: batching + cache 4) 20m canary migration + Q/A.
Anna (CS): Love it. Julie — do you want us to prepare a short pre-read? e.g., current traffic profile + a list of top 3 endpoints you want optimized.
Julie - CedarHealth: Yes please. I'll share a one-pager and traffic sample by Tue EOD.
calendar-bot: Event created: CedarHealth - Hands-on Inference Sprint — Thu, 10:30 AM PT, 90 minutes. Organizer: Anna (CS). Guests: Julie - CedarHealth, Matt S (Solutions), Rafael (CS Lead).
Anna (CS): Logistics: we'll use Zoom + shared notebook. Matt — can you push a lightweight repro to the repo and share the link in #customer-sessions before Wed?
Matt S (Solutions): Yep — I'll add a demo repo + runbook. Link posted by Wed noon.
Julie - CedarHealth: One ask: please include a short segment on cost controls (how caching + quantization suggestions map to cost).
Rafael (CS Lead): Add that to the tuning segment. Also we'll capture two success metrics: 1) 30% lower p95 latency on stripe calls, 2) clear rollback play.
Anna (CS): Noted. I'll add those to the agenda and the invite description.
Julie - CedarHealth: Great — see you Thu. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
Matt S (Solutions): Thanks — looking forward. :thumbsup:
